importantNotes: Zechariah 9:9 — the king riding on a donkey — fulfilled on Palm Sunday.
Zechariah 12:10 — 'they will look on me, the one they have pierced' — fulfilled at the cross.
'Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit' (4:6) — a key principle for God's work.
Thirty pieces of silver (11:12-13) — the price of Jesus' betrayal.
Zechariah is the most messianic of the Minor Prophets.

chapters.1: A call to repentance; the vision of horsemen patrolling the earth; God will comfort Zion.
chapters.2: Vision of a man measuring Jerusalem — the city will be inhabited without walls.
chapters.3: Vision of the high priest Joshua — cleansed and clothed; the Branch is coming.
chapters.4: Vision of the golden lampstand and olive trees — 'not by might, but by my Spirit.'
chapters.5: Vision of the flying scroll (curse on sin) and the woman in the basket (wickedness removed).
chapters.6: Vision of four chariots; the crowning of Joshua — the Branch will build the Temple.
chapters.7: A question about fasting; God wants justice and mercy, not empty rituals.
chapters.8: Promises of restoration — Jerusalem will be called the Faithful City; many nations will seek God.
chapters.9: The coming king rides on a donkey — humble and bringing salvation.
chapters.10: Ask the LORD for rain; God will strengthen Judah and save Joseph's descendants.
chapters.11: The shepherd rejected for thirty pieces of silver; the foolish shepherd.
chapters.12: Jerusalem becomes an immovable rock; 'they will look on me, the one they have pierced.'
chapters.13: A fountain for cleansing from sin; the shepherd struck, the sheep scattered.
chapters.14: The Day of the LORD — the LORD will be king over the whole earth.
